references.text: The warning against forgetting the Lord who brought the people out of Egypt, the same theme of guarding against forgetfulness
Exhortation not to forget the Lord and His commands, laws, and statutes
The command to teach God's words to children, the same theme of passing faith to the next generation
The instruction to teach children God's words, parallel to the obligation to instruct children and grandchildren
The purpose of God's signs was that they should be told to children and grandchildren
The command to tell sons about God's deeds at the Exodus from Egypt
The psalmist describes the duty to tell the next generation about God's works and commands
Exhortation to guard the heart above all, a similar theme of preserving one's soul
Moses exhorts the people to keep these words in their hearts and command their children to obey the law
Stones as a memorial so that children would learn about God's deeds
